            -- 保存原始 require
            local _require = require

            -- 包装 require 函数，支持相对路径
            function require(modname)
                -- 检查是否已加载
                if package.loaded[modname] then
                    return package.loaded[modname]
                end

                -- 首先尝试标准 require
                local ok, result = pcall(_require, modname)
                if ok then
                    return result
                end

                -- 尝试从脚本目录加载（使用 cherry.file API）
                local filepath = script_dir .. "/" .. modname:gsub("%.", "/") .. ".lua"

                -- 优先使用 cherry.file.readText（更可靠）
                local content = nil
                if cherry and cherry.file and cherry.file.readText then
                    content = cherry.file.readText(filepath)
                end

                -- 回退到 io.open
                if not content then
                    local file = io.open(filepath, "r")
                    if file then
                        content = file:read("*all")
                        file:close()
                    end
                end

                if content then
                    local chunk, err = load(content, "@" .. filepath)
                    if chunk then
                        local ret = chunk()
                        package.loaded[modname] = ret or true
                        return ret
                    else
                        error("Error loading module '" .. modname .. "': " .. (err or "unknown"))
                    end
                end

                -- 都失败则报错，输出调试信息
                local exists = cherry and cherry.file and cherry.file.exists and cherry.file.exists(filepath)
                if exists then
                    error("module '" .. modname .. "' found at '" .. filepath .. "' but failed to read")
                else
                    error("module '" .. modname .. "' not found (searched: " .. filepath .. ")")

            function require(modname)
                -- 检查是否已加载
                if package.loaded[modname] then
                    return package.loaded[modname]
                end

                -- 首先尝试标准 require
                local ok, result = pcall(_require, modname)
                if ok then

                end

                -- 尝试从脚本目录加载（使用 cherry.file API）

                -- 优先使用 cherry.file.readText（更可靠）

                if cherry and cherry.file and cherry.file.readText then
                    content = cherry.file.readText(filepath)
                end

                -- 回退到 io.open
                if not content then
                    local file = io.open(filepath, "r")
                    if file then
                        content = file:read("*all")
                        file:close()
                    end
                end

                if content then
                    local chunk, err = load(content, "@" .. filepath)
                    if chunk then
                        local ret = chunk()
                        package.loaded[modname] = ret or true
                        return ret
                    else
                        error("Error loading module '" .. modname .. "': " .. (err or "unknown"))
                    end
                end

                -- 都失败则报错，输出调试信息
                local exists = cherry and cherry.file and cherry.file.exists and cherry.file.exists(filepath)
                if exists then
                    error("module '" .. modname .. "' found at '" .. filepath .. "' but failed to read")
                else
                    error("module '" .. modname .. "' not found (searched: " .. filepath .. ")")
                end
            end

            -- 包装 require 函数，支持相对路径
            function require(modname)
                -- 检查是否已加载
                if package.loaded[modname] then
                    return package.loaded[modname]
                end

                -- 首先尝试标准 require
                local ok, result = pcall(_require, modname)
                if ok then
                    return result
                end

                -- 尝试从脚本目录加载（使用 cherry.file API）
                local filepath = script_dir .. "/" .. modname:gsub("%.", "/") .. ".lua"

                -- 优先使用 cherry.file.readText（更可靠）
                local content = nil
                if cherry and cherry.file and cherry.file.readText then
                    content = cherry.file.readText(filepath)
                end

                -- 回退到 io.open
                if not content then
                    local file = io.open(filepath, "r")
                    if file then
                        content = file:read("*all")
                        file:close()
                    end
                end

                if content then
                    local chunk, err = load(content, "@" .. filepath)
                    if chunk then
                        local ret = chunk()
                        package.loaded[modname] = ret or true
                        return ret
                    else
                        error("Error loading module '" .. modname .. "': " .. (err or "unknown"))
                    end
                end

                -- 都失败则报错，输出调试信息
                local exists = cherry and cherry.file and cherry.file.exists and cherry.file.exists(filepath)
                if exists then
                    error("module '" .. modname .. "' found at '" .. filepath .. "' but failed to read")
                else
                    error("module '" .. modname .. "' not found (searched: " .. filepath .. ")")
                end
            end

            local _require = require

            -- 包装 require 函数，支持相对路径
            function require(modname)
                -- 检查是否已加载
                if package.loaded[modname] then
                    return package.loaded[modname]
                end

                -- 首先尝试标准 require
                local ok, result = pcall(_require, modname)
                if ok then
                    return result
                end

                -- 尝试从脚本目录加载（使用 cherry.file API）
                local filepath = script_dir .. "/" .. modname:gsub("%.", "/") .. ".lua"

                -- 优先使用 cherry.file.readText（更可靠）
                local content = nil
                if cherry and cherry.file and cherry.file.readText then
                    content = cherry.file.readText(filepath)
                end

                -- 回退到 io.open
                if not content then
                    local file = io.open(filepath, "r")
                    if file then
                        content = file:read("*all")
                        file:close()
                    end
                end

                if content then
                    local chunk, err = load(content, "@" .. filepath)
                    if chunk then
                        local ret = chunk()
                        package.loaded[modname] = ret or true
                        return ret
                    else
                        error("Error loading module '" .. modname .. "': " .. (err or "unknown"))
                    end
                end

                -- 都失败则报错，输出调试信息
                local exists = cherry and cherry.file and cherry.file.exists and cherry.file.exists(filepath)
                if exists then
                    error("module '" .. modname .. "' found at '" .. filepath .. "' but failed to read")
                else
                    error("module '" .. modname .. "' not found (searched: " .. filepath .. ")")
                end
            end

            local _require = require

            -- 包装 require 函数，支持相对路径
            function require(modname)
                -- 检查是否已加载
                if package.loaded[modname] then
                    return package.loaded[modname]
                end

                -- 首先尝试标准 require
                local ok, result = pcall(_require, modname)
                if ok then
                    return result
                end

                -- 尝试从脚本目录加载（使用 cherry.file API）
                local filepath = script_dir .. "/" .. modname:gsub("%.", "/") .. ".lua"

                -- 优先使用 cherry.file.readText（更可靠）
                local content = nil
                if cherry and cherry.file and cherry.file.readText then
                    content = cherry.file.readText(filepath)
                end

                -- 回退到 io.open
                if not content then
                    local file = io.open(filepath, "r")
                    if file then
                        content = file:read("*all")
                        file:close()
                    end
                end

                if content then
                    local chunk, err = load(content, "@" .. filepath)
                    if chunk then
                        local ret = chunk()
                        package.loaded[modname] = ret or true
                        return ret
                    else
                        error("Error loading module '" .. modname .. "': " .. (err or "unknown"))
                    end
                end

                -- 都失败则报错，输出调试信息
                local exists = cherry and cherry.file and cherry.file.exists and cherry.file.exists(filepath)
                if exists then
                    error("module '" .. modname .. "' found at '" .. filepath .. "' but failed to read")
                else
                    error("module '" .. modname .. "' not found (searched: " .. filepath .. ")")
                end
            end

            local _require = require

            -- 包装 require 函数，支持相对路径
            function require(modname)
                -- 检查是否已加载
                if package.loaded[modname] then
                    return package.loaded[modname]
                end

                -- 首先尝试标准 require
                local ok, result = pcall(_require, modname)
                if ok then
                    return result
                end

                -- 尝试从脚本目录加载（使用 cherry.file API）
                local filepath = script_dir .. "/" .. modname:gsub("%.", "/") .. ".lua"

                -- 优先使用 cherry.file.readText（更可靠）
                local content = nil
                if cherry and cherry.file and cherry.file.readText then
                    content = cherry.file.readText(filepath)
                end

                -- 回退到 io.open
                if not content then
                    local file = io.open(filepath, "r")
                    if file then
                        content = file:read("*all")
                        file:close()
                    end
                end

                if content then
                    local chunk, err = load(content, "@" .. filepath)
                    if chunk then
                        local ret = chunk()
                        package.loaded[modname] = ret or true
                        return ret
                    else
                        error("Error loading module '" .. modname .. "': " .. (err or "unknown"))
                    end
                end

                -- 都失败则报错，输出调试信息
                local exists = cherry and cherry.file and cherry.file.exists and cherry.file.exists(filepath)
                if exists then
                    error("module '" .. modname .. "' found at '" .. filepath .. "' but failed to read")
                else
                    error("module '" .. modname .. "' not found (searched: " .. filepath .. ")")
                end
            end

            local _require = require

            -- 包装 require 函数，支持相对路径
            function require(modname)
                -- 检查是否已加载
                if package.loaded[modname] then
                    return package.loaded[modname]
                end

                -- 首先尝试标准 require
                local ok, result = pcall(_require, modname)
                if ok then
                    return result
                end

                -- 尝试从脚本目录加载（使用 cherry.file API）
                local filepath = script_dir .. "/" .. modname:gsub("%.", "/") .. ".lua"

                -- 优先使用 cherry.file.readText（更可靠）
                local content = nil
                if cherry and cherry.file and cherry.file.readText then
                    content = cherry.file.readText(filepath)
                end

                -- 回退到 io.open
                if not content then
                    local file = io.open(filepath, "r")
                    if file then
                        content = file:read("*all")
                        file:close()
                    end
                end

                if content then
                    local chunk, err = load(content, "@" .. filepath)
                    if chunk then
                        local ret = chunk()
                        package.loaded[modname] = ret or true
                        return ret
                    else
                        error("Error loading module '" .. modname .. "': " .. (err or "unknown"))
                    end
                end

                -- 都失败则报错，输出调试信息
                local exists = cherry and cherry.file and cherry.file.exists and cherry.file.exists(filepath)
                if exists then
                    error("module '" .. modname .. "' found at '" .. filepath .. "' but failed to read")
                else
                    error("module '" .. modname .. "' not found (searched: " .. filepath .. ")")
                end
            end

            -- 包装 require 函数，支持相对路径
            function require(modname)
                -- 检查是否已加载
                if package.loaded[modname] then
                    return package.loaded[modname]
                end

                -- 首先尝试标准 require
                local ok, result = pcall(_require, modname)
                if ok then
                    return result
                end

                -- 尝试从脚本目录加载（使用 cherry.file API）
                local filepath = script_dir .. "/" .. modname:gsub("%.", "/") .. ".lua"

                -- 优先使用 cherry.file.readText（更可靠）
                local content = nil
                if cherry and cherry.file and cherry.file.readText then
                    content = cherry.file.readText(filepath)
                end

                -- 回退到 io.open
                if not content then
                    local file = io.open(filepath, "r")
                    if file then
                        content = file:read("*all")
                        file:close()
                    end
                end

                if content then
                    local chunk, err = load(content, "@" .. filepath)
                    if chunk then
                        local ret = chunk()
                        package.loaded[modname] = ret or true
                        return ret
                    else
                        error("Error loading module '" .. modname .. "': " .. (err or "unknown"))
                    end
                end

                -- 都失败则报错，输出调试信息
                local exists = cherry and cherry.file and cherry.file.exists and cherry.file.exists(filepath)
                if exists then
                    error("module '" .. modname .. "' found at '" .. filepath .. "' but failed to read")
                else
                    error("module '" .. modname .. "' not found (searched: " .. filepath .. ")")

            function require(modname)
                -- 检查是否已加载

                -- 首先尝试标准 require
                local ok, result = pcall(_require, modname)
                if ok then

                    content = cherry.file.readText(filepath)
                end

                -- 回退到 io.open
                if not content then
                    local file = io.open(filepath, "r")
                    if file then
                        content = file:read("*all")
                        file:close()
                    end
                end

                if content then
                    local chunk, err = load(content, "@" .. filepath)
                    if chunk then
                        local ret = chunk()
                        package.loaded[modname] = ret or true
                        return ret
                    else
                        error("Error loading module '" .. modname .. "': " .. (err or "unknown"))
                    end
                end

                -- 都失败则报错，输出调试信息
                local exists = cherry and cherry.file and cherry.file.exists and cherry.file.exists(filepath)
                if exists then
                    error("module '" .. modname .. "' found at '" .. filepath .. "' but failed to read")
                else
                    error("module '" .. modname .. "' not found (searched: " .. filepath .. ")")
                end
            end
